title: Alla ricerca di nuove modalità di fruizione e partecipazione all'insegna del 'Design Thinking'
summary: The Covid-19 pandemic had a major impact on the cultural sector. Never has the importance of the public for cultural dynamics been more evident than during these years of restrictions and closures. It is to the public, with its needs and characteristics, that this volume is dedicated: edited by Massimo Zicari and Chiara Bernardi as part of a research project conducted at the University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland (SUPSI), it examines the dynamics of cultural supply and consumption in the Canton of Ticino between 2020 and 2022, and aims to provide working tools for professionals in the sector.
